scientific_question: Does same-panel quotienting of the system-specific linear subspace expose the recurring nonlinear callable that failed under cross-bank two-stage residualization?
mechanism: On the common 32-state acquisition panel, project each system response onto the orthogonal complement of its best linear state map; select eight systems by label-blind residual centrality; learn one 32-center RBF representative of the shared quotient function. Per-system inference jointly fits 16 linear coefficients plus one callable coefficient.
generator: new world; hidden P3 nonlinear callable matrices, system-specific linear matrices, eight recurrent and eight unrelated systems; labels and matrices unavailable to fitting/admission
retained_knowledge: 32 centers x4 plus 32x4 kernel output weights =256 scalars
qualification: Controlled-probe engineered recurrence diagnostic using known Euler differencing and an additive linear-plus-callable prior. Not passive inference, unique factorization, or arbitrary mechanism discovery.
